en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural town with fields and grazing animals in the foreground and a compact settlement with various houses, industrial buildings, and a church with a prominent tower in the background. Low hills rise behind the town. The caption in German at the bottom describes Seifhennersdorf and nearby localities, and a small imprint at the lower left identifies the printer and the year 1905.
